originalTitle: Will the DOE Hydrogen Shot Succeed in Reducing the Price of Renewable Hydrogen to $1/kg by 2030?
title: 2030 年底前，可再生氢价格会达到 1 美元/kg 吗？
Will renewable hydrogen reach $1/kg by end-2030?
rules: 原文要求到 2030 年底，可信美国或全球平准化可再生氢价格指数 ≤1 美元/kg。
By end-2030 a credible US or global levelized renewable-hydrogen price index must be ≤$1/kg.
interpretation: 原题将成本目标与价格指数混用；DOE 2023 年文件写 2031 年、清洁氢目标，不能据此替原市场更改年份或路线。
The source mixes cost goals with a price index; DOE’s 2023 release uses 2031 and clean hydrogen, which do not amend the contract.

summary: 预测使用可再生氢的价格门槛，原题背景提到的 DOE 目标与实际判定范围有差别。
The forecast sets a renewable-hydrogen price threshold, differing from the DOE goal cited in its background.
checklist: 核对价格或平准化成本定义与币值。
核对可再生氢路线及地理范围。
区分 2030 市场截止与 2031 官方目标。
Separate the 2030 contract from the 2031 target.

stage: 材料与试验 → 产品验证 → 实际应用
Materials and tests → product verification → application
impact: 催化、电解槽寿命与廉价电力有助于成本改善，但政策目标不是观测价格。IEA 行业规模资料与 DOE 目标分别提供部署和研发背景，不能直接替代符合原题的价格指数。
Catalysis, stack life and electricity can improve cost, but a policy target is not an observed price. IEA deployment and DOE goals provide context rather than the contract’s qualifying price index.
gap: 保留年份与成本／价格定义差异。

title: 电解装机、氢产量与成本
Electrolysis capacity, hydrogen output and cost
principle: 电解水的产氢与产氧反应由电力驱动。效率、利用小时、电价、设备寿命和系统边界共同决定平准化成本，GW 装机不能单独给出年产量。
Electricity drives hydrogen and oxygen evolution. Efficiency, utilization, price, life and system boundaries determine levelized cost; GW capacity alone does not give annual output.
example: IEA 的 2025 年超过 4 GW 是已安装电解容量；接近 1 Mt 低排放氢包含其他路径。DOE 2031 年目标也不同于原题 2030 年价格条件。
IEA’s over 4 GW is 2025 installed electrolysis; almost 1 Mt low-emissions hydrogen includes other routes. DOE’s 2031 target differs from the market’s 2030 condition.

label: 原题口径说明
Source-rule scope
detail: 原题 2030／可再生氢价格与 DOE 资料 2031／清洁氢成本目标不同。
Contract 2030/renewable price differs from DOE 2031/clean-hydrogen cost target.
